name: GitHub Filers
feeds: a Discover Rootflow for the filed-on-a-vendor-repo signal; its door is not built yet (needs the Operator's yes and a card)
schedule: daily, early, before the working day; the task's webhook posts {signal, resource} to the door on run succeeded
description: Watches vendor repos on GitHub for issues and pull requests filed by people at companies that run the tool in production, resolves the filer to an employer and emits one row per company with the filing as evidence. Spends nothing, takes no contact.
